nativeMetric: leaf nodes per second; actual perft with every move applied; no bulk counting; no transposition cache; no evaluation or pruning; root parsing excluded
apiCompatibility: Public JSON/SFEN/USI formats, original FNV/context hashes, pending/history/undo and model guards preserved. Verification-only Heian wrapper does not change production exports.
rejectedTrials: 04C first chained-iterator inline trial: Tenjiku Dai regression
memoryNote: Allocation profiles record cumulative alloc/realloc requested bytes; actual WASM linear memory is separately guarded, including normal 5-second searches.
wasmComparisonScope: Actual previously distributed frontend bundles versus refreshed bundles; per-rule SHA-256 recorded. Native compares source revisions e7ab6ef and d95f3b3 at exactly the same engine path. Ratios are calculated separately within each pair.

commands.rustRule: cargo test --release -p haitaka --features RULE extended (Heian 3 modes: no extended filter)
commands.nativeBuild: cargo build --release -p haitaka_cli --no-default-features --features RULE; copy target/release/haitaka_cli to target/haitaka-RULE
commands.wasmBuild: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=-simd128' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p haitaka_wasm --no-default-features --features RULE
commands.jsonNativeAndWasm: LARGE_HASH_WORKERS=4 node scripts/verify-large-hashes.mjs target RULE target/performance-original-wasm/RULE
commands.heianNativeOracle: cargo run --release -p haitaka --features RULE --example rule_oracle -- 128 haitaka/tests/fixtures/heian/RULE.sfen > target/RULE-transitions.tsv
commands.heianSource: HAITAKA_ENGINE_DIR=ENGINE HEIAN_PERFT=1 HEIAN_REPORT=OUTPUT.json pnpm exec vitest run app/bot/heianReference.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
commands.aiCi: CI=1 pnpm exec vitest run --root packages/ai
commands.browser: SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 BASE_URL=http://localhost:3002 PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=/tmp/performance-final-browser.json pnpm exec playwright test tests/haitaka-*.spec.ts --config .tmp/dai-dai.playwright.config.ts --project chromium --workers 2 --reporter=line,json
commands.nativeBefore: git -C target/perft-original switch --detach e7ab6efc40e8838d62185e6a69d96a3ad28041e8; python3 scripts/perft-benchmark.py --cpu 7 --engine-dir target/perft-original --output target/perft-original-final.json
commands.nativeAfter: git -C target/perft-original switch --detach d95f3b3; python3 scripts/perft-benchmark.py --cpu 7 --engine-dir target/perft-original --compare target/perft-original-final.json --output target/perft-final.json
commands.positionsBefore: git -C target/perft-original switch --detach e7ab6efc40e8838d62185e6a69d96a3ad28041e8; python3 scripts/perft-position-benchmark.py --engine-dir target/perft-original --positions plans/historical-shogi-performance/inputs/positions.json --output target/positions-original-final.json
commands.positionsAfter: git -C target/perft-original switch --detach d95f3b3; python3 scripts/perft-position-benchmark.py --engine-dir target/perft-original --positions plans/historical-shogi-performance/inputs/positions.json --compare target/positions-original-final.json --output target/positions-final.json
commands.wasmPerft: taskset -c 7 node scripts/benchmark-wasm-perft.mjs target/performance-original-wasm SHOGITTER/app/bot/vendors/haitaka target/wasm-performance-final.json
